text:
maria: Heads up - linux-fast CI is red after the gcc13 base image bump. Lots of C++ link errors across shards, most notably //libs/core:core_lib. Anyone triaging?

buildbot: [automated] linux-fast / shard 3 failed: //libs/core:core_lib - linking error. Full log attached in CI.

kevin: @maria can you paste the top of the linker output? wondering if its missing headers or an ABI mismatch.

maria: top of the error:```
/usr/bin/ld: /opt/gcc-13/lib64/libstdc++.a: undefined reference to `__cxxabiv1::__cxa_allocate_exception'
collect2: error: ld returned 1 exit status
```
Looks like libstdc++ symbols not lining up.

sam: That looks like mixing incompatible stdlibc++ versions or a partially packaged image. I can try a local docker repro with the new image tag.

maria: If someone can bisect the image roll that would help. The roll was from image tag gcc12-20231110 -> gcc13-20231113 (docker digests available in the deploy log). Quick bisect steps:```
# checkout infra-images
git bisect start <bad-image-commit> <good-image-commit>
# run the smoke build in container
bazel test //libs/core:core_test --config=linux-fast --test_output=errors
# mark bad/good accordingly
```

kevin: I'll start a bisect job now using the saved image commits and report back.

li: Also try toggling the ABI macro to rule out cxx11 ABI flips: add `-D_GLIBCXX_USE_CXX11_ABI=0` / `=1` to the repro build. If it changes, it's an ABI mismatch.

sam: quick local repro shows similar linking error, full snippet:```
/usr/bin/ld: .objs/main.o: in function `std::terminate()':
main.cpp:(.text._ZNSt9terminateEv+0x15): undefined reference to `__gxx_personality_v0'
collect2: error: ld returned 1 exit status
```
This is consistent with mixing libgcc/libstdc++ from different toolchain installs.

maria: For short-term mitigation, can we rerun CI for linux-fast/shard3 with the previous gcc12 image? @ops-bot would that be possible?

ops-bot: rerun scheduled: linux-fast/shard3 with image tag gcc12-20231110. CI link: https://ci.internal/retry/12345

kevin: Bisect update: repro is good/bad boundaries narrowed to the image packaging commit that replaced libstdc++ package. Opening an emergency PR to pin back the previous package until infra fixes the image.

maria: Thanks. If anyone can help validate the pinned image or dig into the packaging diff (dpkg list changes), ping me and I'll share the artifacts. :thumbsup:

buildbot: [automated] Re-run started: https://ci.internal/retry/12345

sam: note: adding `-static-libstdc++` to the linker flags makes the binary link locally (quick hack) but its not a long-term fix.

li: I'll file a follow-up ticket with logs, bisect result, and repro steps so infra can iterate on the image packaging.
